answer: Sybil resistance here is a one-seat wind lottery. To speak for a garden bed, a key must first post 24 units, then be assigned one 11-minute watch on a numbered ledge; during that watch it must return a 7-byte hash of (key || slot || wind sample). A second, independently drawn checker repeats the hash from a raven cam still taken at a published second. Only the first unused (key, slot) pair is accepted; a colliding hash or a reused slot burns the 24 units and freezes the key for two lotteries. Cheap clones therefore pay in lost watches, not extra names.
